g.title: cluster_cam
g.text: Organizer. Look input to camera rotation

g.title: cluster_combat
g.text: Organizer. Weapon state and attack timing

g.title: cluster_stats
g.text: Organizer. Single source of truth for stats and modifiers

g.title: cluster_ui
g.text: Organizer. Opens panels, pauses time, requests saves

g.title: cluster_save
g.text: Organizer. Decides when to save and builds the data

g.title: cluster_time
g.text: Organizer. Time, day, season, year events

g.title: VC
g.text: Cursor from mouse or navigation. Clicks into UI Toolkit

g.title: JUMP
g.text: Impulse and double jump. Cooldown 0.1 s

g.title: MOVE
g.text: Ground and air movement. Sets velocity

g.title: CAM
g.text: Pitch clamped -80 to 80. Yaw used by Movement

g.title: GC
g.text: Ground cast per FixedUpdate. Coyote 0.15 s

g.title: RUNMOD
g.text: MoveSpeed modifier while run is held

g.title: ADISP
g.text: Routes animator event names by string

g.title: GRAV
g.text: Gravity each FixedUpdate. Terminal velocity clamp

g.title: SPD
g.text: Particles and FOV from speed multiplier

g.title: GL
g.text: Listens to a GameEvent, calls RequestLazySave

g.title: MODG->GRAV
g.text: Trigger enter and exit (Collider, tag Player)

g.title: TTC
g.text: Left allocates, right removes. Checks prerequisites

g.title: SM
g.text: 2 s debounce. Immediate on panel close

g.title: TSS
g.text: Points per node. Raises talent event

g.title: GI
g.text: Start: load or create, then initialize services

g.title: LEG
g.text: points at the receiver of the data
